newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore con artist in US$1 million note scam.
newsitem.headline: Singapore con artist in US$1 million note scam.

text.p: Two people were cheated into parting with thousands of dollars in cash and jewellery by a con man who paid them with a fake US$1 million note, the Straits Times reported on Saturday.
Victim Ismail Marican, 54, said he gave the man his watch and gold ring for which he was given a one thousand dollar note, but could not recall the currency.
He said the con man then persuaded his aunt to part with a gold chain and bracelet worth S$2,050 and took the thousand dollar note back, exchanging it for the US$1 million fake.
The con man, described as slick and smooth talking, said he would return later to get the change, but was not seen again.

Ismail, who also gave the man S$1,300 in cash told the Straits Times: "I waited and waited. When an hour passed and he still did not come back, I began to feel suspicious. Now I know I have been very stupid. I won't trust people so easily again."
